description: Return word completions for a given prefix string using the Datamuse suggestion endpoint. Takes a prefix (e.g., "hel") and returns matching words ranked by score (e.g., "hello", "help", "helpless").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

prefix.description: The prefix to autocomplete (e.g. "hel" returns "hello", "help", etc.)

name: autocomplete
